name: lettering_size_is_read_on_the_axes_of_the_face
why: THE WIDTH AND THE HEIGHT OF A LETTERING, ON A FACE THAT IS NOT NORMAL TO Z. engrave_text read them as the box of the outlines on X and on Y whatever the face: right on a face whose normal is Z (all the earlier cases are on the front plane), and on the top face of a plate, whose lettering lies in X and Z, the «height» was the extent along Y, that is nothing. The twin of code_engraved_in_the_center on the top plane: the same block, the same «PROVA», the same anchor, the same numbers.
defect_caught: On a face with normal Y or X the answer said height_written_mm 0 (and, on a face with normal X, a width of 0): the number that tells whoever reads that a lettering is 10 mm tall was wrong, and the overflow message printed the same wrong sizes. Found writing the cut-through case of 0.131.0 on the top face of a plate.

expect.tolerance_why: the width comes from the drawing of the glyphs of the font, as in the twin
as in the twin: this is the number that was 0 on this face
expect.why: 10.51 is the height of the lettering on the face; on the top face it used to come out 0

expect.tolerance_why: the volume of an engraving is the sum of 56 curved outlines
the same number as the twin
